name: ghost-guild-agents
description: GHOST — six scripted red-team personas that emit detection-validation events (MOCK mode).
comment:guild-sdk: The six agent entrypoints import @guildai/agents-sdk, which is provided by the Guild runtime (and installed by `guild agent init`). It is NOT required to run `npm run mock`. To typecheck the agent files locally, run `npm i -D @guildai/agents-sdk` then `npm run typecheck:agents`. The Guild runtime also supplies its own zod to deployed agents.
